# Untitled.jpg — Overthinking Undervalued Means of Thought

> Essays, field notes, curated bookmarks, and practical resources on AI perception, cognitive psychophysics, high-dimensional latent spaces, and media archaeology.

Author: Juan Pablo Giusepponi (Sr. Designer, Head of Communication & Frontier AI Specialist)
Canonical URL: https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/index.html 

## Thematic Pillars

1. **Visual Perception & Cognitive Psychophysics**: Investigating how human vision, neural architectures, and aesthetic structures decode latent visual representations.
2. **Frontier AI & Machine Vision**: High-dimensional vector spaces, JEPA world models, multi-modal generative systems, and rubric-based benchmark evaluation.
3. **Language, Latent Structures & Media Archaeology**: Epistemology of media from Preciado and Foucault to modern vector spaces and algorithmic culture.
4. **Art Direction, Cultural Shanzhai & Visual Strategy**: Deconstruction of originality, design systems, and federal independent publishing.

## Key Dispatches & Articles

- [The Pharmacopornographic Episteme & AI Latent Spaces](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/telebody-latent-space-pharmacopornographic-ai.html): Synthetic bodies, bio-capitalism, and generative neural desire.
- [Why AI Agents Look Like Tamagotchis](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/why-ai-agents-look-like-tamagotchis.html): Visual anthropomorphism, emotional interfaces, and synthetic agency.
- [Visual Bandwidth Bottleneck](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/visual-bandwidth-bottleneck.html): Human cognitive processing throughput in multi-modal generative interfaces.
- [Shanzhai: Deconstructing the Original](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/shanzhai-deconstructing-original.html): Byung-Chul Han, iterative reproduction, and generative model weights.
- [LeCun's World Models & JEPA](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/lecun-world-models-jepa.html): Non-generative Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture in perception.
- [Foucault, Borges & Vector Space](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/foucault-borges-vector-space.html): High-dimensional semantic embeddings as encyclopedic topologies.

- [Home & Dispatch Matrix](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/index.html): Asymmetric split reader with live filtering across Essays, Notes, Bookmarks, and Resources.
